title: Store Pickup Standard: Customer Wait Settlement of Ridgeline Special Order Services Delay Credits
content:
The delay credit on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program whose deposit at order is 50 percent is settled for the customer's own wait — the time the ready item waited at the store before pickup or delivery.

**Clause.** The customer's own wait is the calendar days from the ready date to the completed date, and 0 while the item has not been handed over. The delay credit figure, once rounded to the nearest cent and held to no more than the program's delay credit maximum, is settled as follows: an own wait of more than 45 days halves it, rounded to the nearest cent; more than 21 days and not more than 45 days takes 25.00 off it, never below zero; otherwise it stands. The settled figure is the delay credit posted.

## Wait bands

| Calendar days from ready date to completed date | Settlement |
|---|---|
| 46 or more | halved, rounded to the nearest cent |
| 22 to 45 | 25.00 taken off, never below zero |
| 0 to 21, or not handed over | the figure stands |

## Worked figures (hypothetical figures already rounded and held to the maximum)

| Figure | Own wait | Delay credit posted |
|---|---|---|
| 250.00 | 50 days | 125.00 |
| 250.00 | 30 days | 225.00 |
| 18.40 | 30 days | 0.00 |
| 164.90 | 21 days | 164.90 |
| 164.90 | not handed over | 164.90 |
